title: NSS Feed Output Format: Authentication Logs

blocks.text: The Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS) feed specifies the data from the Authentication logs that the NSS sends to the security information and event management (SIEM) system. You can configure an NSS feed by including one or more fields. The fields and their values display in the NSS feed output.
The following tables display information about the Authentication log fields and example values for those fields:

Fields that support obfuscation are documented in the following tables with the prefix o (e.g., %s{oresource}). To obfuscate a field, manually add the prefix o before the field name in the Feed Output Format.

table: The time and date of the transaction. This excludes the time zone.
The time zone. This is the same as the time zone you specified when you configured the NSS feed.
The epoch time of the transaction
The action performed by the admin in the Zscaler Admin Console
The specific entity within a subcategory
The obfuscated version of the resource.
Displays a random string in the output
The means by which the user performs their actions
The interface will either be the Admin UI or an API
The source IP address for the admin
The unique record identifier for each log
The location in the Zscaler Admin Console where the action was performed
The entity under the selected category where the action was performed
